card_text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, the new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

card_text: Each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +30 HP.
card_text_de: Jedes Basis-Pokémon im Spiel (deine und die deines Gegners) erhält +30 KP.

card_text: Your opponent counts the cards in their hand, shuffles those cards, and puts them on the bottom of their deck. If they do, they draw that many cards.

card_text: Discard all Pokémon Tools and Special Energy from all of your opponent's Pokémon, and discard a Stadium in play.

card_text: Put up to 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your hand.

card_text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent's [ W ] Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance) , and discard this card.

card_text: Search your deck for any number of Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

card_text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, you may move as many Energy attached to the old Active Pokémon to the new Active Pokémon as you like.

card_text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
